messages:
Nima R: Ventana Bio requested a 2-hour hands-on enablement to walk through Dedicated capacity sizing, rollout playbook, and post-migration checks. Prefer mornings PT in late May.
Hannah L: Good. Do they want workshop or office-hours format?
Nima R: Workshop - they want step-by-step migration with demo and a short runbook. Suggested attendee list: AM, infra engineer, security lead.
Omar T: I can own the Dedicated sizing + live deploy demo. Mornings PT after 09:30 work for me.
Hannah L: I can handle rollout playbook, runbook checklist, and success criteria. I'm out 2026-05-26 though.
Nima R: Propose 2026-05-27 09:30-11:30 PT. That avoids the 26th conflict.
Omar T: 05-27 works. Should we ask for prework? e.g., current token distribution and whether they plan to use KMS/HSM?
Hannah L: Yes. Also request their expected qps and peak concurrency so we can prepare autoscale recommendations.
cs_bot: Created provisional event https://cal.example/event/2765432100 and poll https://doodle.example/ventana-enable-2765.
Nima R: Draft agenda (keep tight):

1) 09:30-09:40: Intros & goals (AM + CS)
2) 09:40-10:10: Sizing & capacity planning (Omar)
3) 10:10-10:40: Live deploy + smoke checks (Omar)
4) 10:40-11:05: Rollout playbook, canary & rollback (Hannah)
5) 11:05-11:20: Post-migration verification & alerting (Hannah)
6) 11:20-11:30: Next steps, action items, feedback form

Omar T: Recommend 5-min prework: provide example traces and 2 typical prompts for post-deploy sanity test. We'll keep the demo small (single model + basic KV cache).
Hannah L: I'll draft the prework email and the feedback form. Can cs_bot attach the form to event?
cs_bot: Added placeholder feedback form https://forms.example/ventana-feedback and attached to event.
Nima R: Can we schedule a 30-min dry-run with facilitators on 2026-05-26 09:00 PT? Invite only facilitators.
Omar T: Yes, I can do that.
Hannah L: Works for me too. I'll reserve the 'Enablement Room A' if any Redwooder wants to join in person.
Nima R: I'll send the agenda + prework to the Ventana AM and update this thread when they confirm. Thanks all. :v:
